name: PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote cage fish farming. It provides grants per unit to the individuals and groups for sustainable aquaculture practices.
descriptionMd: The "Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme" was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, under the umbrella scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana". It aims to promote sustainable aquaculture practices by supporting cage fish farming in water bodies. Under this scheme, a grant of ₹3,00,000/- per unit to the individuals and groups for setting up cage fish farms, thereby encouraging entrepreneurship, increasing fish production, and generating employment.
benefitsMd: **Grant Amount:** - ₹3,00,000/- per unit (per cage). **Grant Proportion:** - 40% of unit cost for General Category beneficiaries. - 60% of unit cost for Scheduled Caste/Women beneficiaries. **Cage Limit for Assistance:** - Up to 5 cages for individual farmers. - Up to 20 cages for registered cooperative societies/self-help groups/joint liability groups (with at least 10 members).
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant should be an individual farmer, cooperative society, self-help group, or joint liability group. 
1. The cooperative society, self-help group, or joint liability group having a minimum of 10 members. 
1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra).
1. The applicant must obtain prior permission from the Government of Haryana and competent authorities.
1. The cage location must have year-round water availability and a minimum of 8 meters depth.
1. The applicant should take government permission for rearing exotic fish species.
